8303.title: Provider command selection triggers unintended submission
8303.rootCauseOneLine: The composer treats built-in discovery origin as immediate-submit policy, so selecting a live provider command schedules submission.

prReviews.verdict: Static-only: addresses the reproduced selection guard; runtime and caret behavior unverified.

8303.proposedFix: Limit immediate submission to explicit standalone slash-command actions; leave other provider commands editable. Existing linked PR #8304 already targets this path.
8303.caveats: Component boundary reproduced twice on trusted main; real provider execution, touch input, and mobile DOM caret behavior were not exercised. Full reproduction test is inline in the report.
